about: The baseline of Tools/Checks/check-personal-data.ps1 (Q190 (a)): per file and rule, how many occurrences of
personal data HEAD may still hold - more fails, fewer is reported so the ceiling comes down. It names files and
rule ids only. The identifiers themselves, and anything derived from them, live only in the maintainer's
checkout, in .work/personal-data/identifiers.json (Q196 (c)); the guard refuses this file if it carries any.
